title: tac.sitrep
description: A short situation report for one own unit: position, weapon manager and missiles, current target as a track number, C2 task and the top threats to it. Needs the BDArmory binding in a flight scene (EXECUTOR_UNAVAILABLE tactical_not_attached without it).

unit.description: own unit: a handle "v:<id>", a vessel id or an exact unit name.

units.description: distance units for text: nm (naval: nm, kt, ft) or km (metric)
